controllers.status.description: Tells you whether game controller input is running and how.
controllers.status.returns: running (true/false), backend (the controller library in use), version, state, message (a status line) and mode (the watch setting from the Controllers page).

controllers.list.description: Lists the game controllers that are plugged in right now. Starts watching controllers if it was not already. Fails with an error when controller input is turned off.
controllers.list.returns: A list of controllers. Each has its name, slot number, type, battery, held buttons, axes (stick and trigger values) and hats (d-pad directions).

controllers.get.description: Finds one game controller and tells you about it. Starts watching controllers if needed.

parameters.controller: Optional. Which controller: a slot like "#1", part of its name, its type (like "PS5") or its GUID. Default "#1".

controllers.get.returns: The controller's details (name, slot, type, battery, held buttons, axes, hats), or null when none matches.

controllers.rumble.description: Makes a game controller shake (rumble). Fails with an error when controller input is turned off.

parameters.controller: Optional. Which controller: a slot like "#1", part of its name, its type or GUID. Several can be split with commas. Default "Any" (all of them).
parameters.low: Optional. Strength of the big, slow motor, 0-100 percent. Default 50.
parameters.high: Optional. Strength of the small, fast motor, 0-100 percent. Default 50.
parameters.durationMs: Optional. How long to shake, in milliseconds (1000 = 1 second, at most 60000). Default 500.

controllers.setLed.description: Changes the light colour on game controllers that have one, like a PlayStation controller. Fails with an error when the colour cannot be read.

parameters.controller: Optional. Which controller: a slot like "#1", part of its name, its type or GUID. Default "Any" (all of them).
parameters.color: The colour as "#RRGGBB" (like "#FF0000" for red) or "r,g,b" (like "255,0,0").

controllers.learn.description: Waits for you to press a button, move a stick or push the d-pad, then tells you what it was. Handy for finding a button's name.

parameters.timeoutMs: Optional. How long to wait, in milliseconds (100 to 300000). Default 10000 (10 seconds).
parameters.controller: Optional. Only listen to this controller (slot like "#1", name, type or GUID). Leave it out to listen to all.

controllers.learn.returns: What was pressed: kind, name, label, controller (its details), triggerType, settings and description. null when nothing was pressed in time.

controllers.reloadMappings.description: Reads the controller mappings file (gamecontrollerdb.txt) again, so new controller types are known. Fails with an error when there is no such file.
controllers.reloadMappings.returns: How many mappings were added. 0 when controller input is not running yet (the file is read when it starts).
